llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk: it ships documentation and a tiny shell helper that prints help/status/info and contains a TODO for actual functionality. If you install it, verify you trust the author if you expect more advanced behavior (the run command is not implemented and there are no network calls or credential requests). As with any third-party code, inspect or run in a sandbox if you plan to execute scripts or extend functionality. Autonomous invocation is allowed by default on the platform but this skill does not request additional privileges or secrets.
